dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses COPY with .INC files, grpsys-prefixed lines, and shell/job management calls typical of the ORCA system.

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA Japanese medical receipt (CSVファイル作成 - CSV creation) processing system for medical insurance claims
purpose.summary: ORCGE02 is a component of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It handles CSV file creation for medical claim (receipt/CSB) output processing, managing job control, screen transitions, and file I/O for claim condition files. It interacts with shell scripts and job management subsystems to produce output files under specified conditions.

notable_features: 23 COPY statements for modular include files (.INC)
15 CALL statements including ORCSJOB job management
LINKAGE SECTION with MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA
BINARY (S9(9) BINARY) usage instead of COMP-3
grpsys-prefixed conditional COPY lines for group system variant
Shell script invocation via job management (orcbse01.sh)
verdict.notes: File is encoded in latin-1 but contains Japanese EUC-JP text in comments (mojibake due to encoding mismatch). The grpsys prefix on some COPY lines suggests a conditional compilation or variant build mechanism. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 76610 bytes total. The program appears to be a screen-driven online subprogram (not CICS but ORCA's own MCP framework), so program_type is set to online-cics as the closest match for an interactive screen program within a proprietary framework.
